Diagnosis.submission: The user-service Kubernetes Service (ClusterIP) is missing from the social-network namespace. The user-service deployment and pod are running and healthy (listening on port 9090), but without a Kubernetes Service object, other microservices cannot resolve the user-service hostname via DNS and cannot connect to it via Thrift RPC. This causes failures in all operations that depend on user service calls (login, register, post composition, timeline reads, etc.).
